stemMd: Which comparison would best implement the historians’ recommendation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Assume family letters and formal ledgers cover identical populations.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Compare only the physical distance of routes.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Treat all absent policies as evidence of zero perceived risk.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Compare premiums while also examining merchants’ access to alternative risk-sharing institutions.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Exclude every policy covering a long route.

explanationMd: Including access information addresses the proposed selection mechanism while retaining geographical factors that may also affect risk.

distractorRationale.b: Distance omits the institutional selection emphasized.
distractorRationale.e: The passage supplies no rationale for that restriction.
distractorRationale.a: They may record different arrangements and participants.
